stem: According to the information in “Consider This,” how is a spider weaving a web similar to Homan Walsh flying the kite?

options.label: F
options.text: Both depend on the wind for success.

options.label: G
options.text: Both rely on others to complete their task.

options.label: H
options.text: Both create something that is useful to others.

options.label: J
options.text: Both experience failure in the beginning stages of their work.
